name: Guardian Circuit Breaker — Prevent Cascading Failures
description: Implement CircuitBreaker in src/circuit-breaker.ts that trips to OPEN after threshold failures.

inputs.task_prompt: Implement CircuitBreaker in src/circuit-breaker.ts: states 'CLOSED' | 'OPEN'. execute<T>(fn: () => T): T executes fn. If 3 consecutive calls fail, trip to 'OPEN'. In 'OPEN' state, throw Error('Circuit breaker is OPEN'). Ensure test/circuit-breaker.test.ts passes.

acceptance_criteria: CircuitBreaker starts CLOSED and executes calls normally
Trips to OPEN after 3 consecutive failures
Rejects calls immediately while OPEN without invoking fn
